items.title: Texas governor race tightens in prediction markets, but Abbott remains favored
items.summary: Political observers are watching the Texas gubernatorial election for signs of an artificial intelligence data center backlash in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday, and prediction market traders see growing odds of the Democratic candidate pulling off an upset.
